verdict.rationale: Plaid documents an official MCP server (plaid-idv-probe-4), which could let AI agents invoke Plaid APIs—including Identity Verification—via natural-language-driven tool calls. However, there is no IDV-specific documentation of natural-language command support, conversational interfaces, or examples of using MCP with the Identity Verification product itself. Missing for 10: IDV-specific natural-language interaction examples, evidence of the MCP server exposing IDV endpoints, and any hands-on/community confirmation of this workflow.
